scope: F36 chart inspection; complete chart-family and adjacent chart behavior accounting, not F37 editing or full live-model parity.
notice: Research/provenance only. Original TypeScript markup and assertions; no copied source fixture. Existing research notices upstream-license-notice.txt and test-case-map-notice.txt remain applicable to inherited evidence.
selection: Every tests/chart row, tests/parts/test_chart row and features/cht-* expanded row; additionally every inventory identity or expanded BDD step mentioning chart. Selection includes chart-format and chart-bearing shape obligations. Each parameter variant and expanded example remains separate.
inventoryPolicy: Historical source ledgers are not rewritten. Behavior links preserve exact assertions, parameter fixture closure and exception evidence. A partial inspection assertion is never whole-row parity. Deferred rows are visible gaps, not architecture exemptions.
